build_exaone_causal_lm: build an inference-only ExaoneForCausalLM model compatible with HuggingFace weights
create_exaone_decoder_layer: create an ExaoneDecoderLayer with attention, gated MLP, and RMSNorm components
create_exaone_attention: create an ExaoneAttention module with QKV projection, rotary embeddings, and RadixAttention
create_exaone_gated_mlp: create an ExaoneGatedMLP with merged gate/up projections and SiluAndMul activation
load_exaone_weights: load HuggingFace checkpoint weights into an ExaoneForCausalLM with shard mapping support
